test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 21 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Eight friends, P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W, are sitting in the same order anticlockwise around a circular table at equal distance between them, with all facing centre of the table. If Q is sitting in the south-east, then in which direction is W sitting?
solution:
Given : Eight friends, P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W, are sitting in **the same order anticlockwise** around a circular table at equal distance between them, with all **facing centre **of the table.

 
• Q is sitting in the south-east

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69e18018ec62338c93574a0c3b6464fababd14c1cd8f3f6cb3c6edef9907a76e.png] 

⇒ As per the final arrangement 'W' is sitting in the south-west direction.

Hence, **"South-west"** is the correct answer.
